content:
sara_pm: Quick sync — we need a final call on model capability flags + discovery endpoint shape. Customer asks for a small, stable surface; eng wants flexibility. Tradeoffs?

jen_eng: +1. My proposal: discovery returns a capability map with stable keys. Include token_limits, streaming:true/false, supported_tools array, and function_calling enum (none|partial|full).

omar_devex: Prefer an enum for rollout state rather than booleans — e.g. capability_level: none/beta/ga. Easier for telemetry and UI. Also include observability_tags so DevEx can map events to flags.

lina_se: From SE side — customers ask for per-route overrides and the ability to mark certain structured-output fields as required. They also want a human-readable "compatibility_notes" for quirks.

sara_pm: Here's a minimal example sketch of the discovery response I mocked for scoping: 

```json
{
  "model": "redwood-xxl-v1",
  "capabilities": {
    "chat": "ga",
    "completions": "ga",
    "embeddings": "beta",
    "rerank": "none",
    "streaming": true,
    "function_calling": "partial",
    "structured_output": "beta"
  },
  "supported_tools": ["http_fetch", "sql_runner"],
  "token_limits": {
    "soft_limit": 8192,
    "hard_limit": 16384,
    "recommended_chunk_size": 1024
  },
  "on_prem_compatible": false,
  "compatibility_notes": "use kv-cache v2 for low-latency streaming"
}
```

jen_eng: A few engineering notes: keep payload <2KB and cacheable (ETag/Last-Modified). token_limits should be integers and we need both soft and hard so SDKs can warn. function_calling needs a versioned schema.

omar_devex: Also expose a minimal /v1/models/:id/capabilities so infra can serve it from model metadata cache. Telemetry events: capability_query, capability_mismatch, override_applied.

lina_se: Launch criteria suggestion: (1) stable schema published and SDKs parse enums (2) per-route overrides implemented and tested (3) at least one customer on beta using structured_output flags (4) console shows capability surface and recent queries.

raj_cs: Customers (enterprise) specifically request explicit flags for privacy/KMS and an on_prem_compatible boolean. Also they want a changelog entry and advance notice for GA.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Heads up — serving runtime needs a small change to expose recommended_chunk_size in the metadata cache before API GA.

omar_devex: Risk notes: mixing too many nested fields causes SDK churn. Keep top-level cap keys flat; additional metadata can live under a single "meta" map.

jen_eng: Actionable plan: I'll open an API PR with schema + example response. Make it opt-in initially (header X-Discover-Version: 1). We'll add ETag and a small TTL cache.

omar_devex: I'll add telemetry events and DevEx dashboard tickets.

lina_se: I'll draft the customer-facing note + sample code snippets for per-route overrides.

raj_cs: I'll collect enterprise asks and return a prioritized list by EOD Friday.

sara_pm: Timeline: API PR by end of week, beta test with 2 customers in 3 weeks, GA criteria based on Lina/Marq signoff and telemetry maturity. Targeting beta 2026-04-07.

jen_eng: PR ETA EOW. Beta 4/07 is optimistic but doable if infra work lands this week.

omar_devex: I'll post telemetry events doc in #devex after this thread.

lina_se: :thumbsup:

sara_pm: Thanks all — will update the initiative doc and ping stakeholders.
